summary: Provides hashing utilities including SHA-256 computation for strings, bytes, files, and objects, as well as truncated hash generation.
responsibilities: Compute SHA-256 hashes for strings, bytes, files, and arbitrary objects, including truncated hash representations.
relationships: Computes cryptographic and non-cryptographic hashes for files, objects, bytes, and strings.
design_decisions: Provides utility functions for hashing strings, bytes, objects, and files using SHA-256 algorithms.
